# Builds and synergies

English · [简体中文](Builds-zh-CN.md)

[Home](Home.md) · [Cards](Cards.md) · [Builds](Builds.md) · [Enemies](Enemies.md) · [Stages](Stages.md) · [Mechanics](Mechanics.md) · [Development](Development.md) · [Changelog](Changelog.md) · [Gallery](Gallery.md) · [Brand](Brand.md) · [Validation](Validation.md)

![Current Build panel: stats, collected augments and family thresholds](../assets/screenshots/build-desktop-v1.png)

Each card acquisition, including duplicates and epics, adds one family stack. Tiers unlock at 3 / 6 / 9 and different families can coexist. Higher tiers keep lower effects, replacing a stated multiplier, threshold or interval rather than adding both values. Cards below their own cap remain available after nine family stacks.

Stage one offers Barrage, Might, Precision and Storm; other families unlock in stage two. Guided offers favor invested families and retain foundational offense; an epic promotion may replace a family slot.

## Starfall Blast / 殉星自爆

Cards: Overload Sigil, Ember Fuse, Starfall Pact, Supernova Heart.

| Stacks | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| 3 | Ordinary kills explode, including source maximum-HP damage; +40% total explosion damage, radius 160. |
| 6 | Explosion kills can chain; automatic sacrifice every 4s. |
| 9 | +100% explosion damage, radius 190; sacrifice every 3s with an extra 45% maximum-HP component. |

## Prayer Barrage / 祷言弹幕

Cards: Swift Chant, Forked Prayer, Causal Pierce, Heavenly Barrage.

| Stacks | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| 3 | Firing interval reduced another 12%; secondaries deal 80% primary damage. |
| 6 | Every fourth volley adds a full volley; secondaries deal 100%. |
| 9 | Firing interval reduced 25%, +1 projectile, full extra volley every third volley. |

## Percentage Erosion / 百分比侵蚀

Cards: Life Rend, Decay Mark, Entropy Pulse, Event Horizon.

| Stacks | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| 3 | Percentage damage from erosion cards +25%. |
| 6 | Arena erosion pulse interval falls from 4s to 3s. |
| 9 | Double erosion percentage damage; pulse interval 2s. |

Build enough damage, firing speed, projectiles or area coverage before relying on recovery. Lifesteal comes only from actual basic enemy HP damage, not explosions, counters or chests. These are current rules, not a claim of completed balance.
